review_candidates.title: Geographic Information System Specialist GIS)
review_candidates.description: Distance Infra (DI) is expanding its professional team and is currently looking for a highly motivated and experienced GIS Specialist to join our office in Zahraa El Maadi, Cairo . The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting our infrastructure and engineering projects through effective spatial data management, advanced GIS analysis, mapping, and the development of reliable geospatial solutions. The position will also involve close coordination with multidisciplinary engineering and BIM teams to ensure that GIS data is accurately integrated into project workflows and supports informed decision-making. 🔹 Position: GIS Specialist Experience Required: 5–10 years Location: Zahraa El Maadi, Cairo, Egypt Key Responsibilities: Collect, process, organize, and maintain spatial data from multiple sources. Build and manage geodatabases in accordance with industry best practices. Ensure the quality, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of GIS data. Prepare and continuously update GIS layers, maps, and attribute databases. Perform spatial analysis, geoprocessing, and mapping to support infrastructure design and planning activities. Develop thematic maps, layouts, asset maps, and other GIS deliverables. Support infrastructure asset management through accurate and structured geospatial information. Coordinate with Roads, Wet Utilities, Dry Utilities, Landscape, Planning, and BIM teams to integrate GIS information with engineering and project data. Support field data collection activities and GPS surveys when required. Prepare professional reports, dashboards, maps, and visualizations for project teams and management. Maintain proper project documentation and follow established project procedures and standards. 💻 Required Software & Technical Skills: Strong practical experience with: ArcGIS Pro / ArcMap ArcGIS Online ArcGIS Enterprise / Portal QGIS – preferred AutoCAD – for engineering drawing coordination and reference Microsoft Excel – for data management and analysis Other GIS tools such as ModelBuilder, Spatial Analyst , and related geoprocessing applications. Experience in infrastructure projects and multidisciplinary engineering environments will be highly valued. Why Join Distance Infra? At Distance Infra , we believe that successful projects are built by strong teams. You will have the opportunity to work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects while collaborating with experienced professionals across different engineering disciplines. We provide an environment focused on continuous learning, technical development, teamwork, innovation, and professional growth . If you have solid GIS experience, a strong understanding of spatial data, and the ability to transform geospatial information into practical solutions for engineering and infrastructure projects, we would be pleased to hear from you. 📩 Apply now by sending your updated CV to: info@distance-infra.com Please mention “GIS Specialist” in the email subject. Join Distance Infra and help us turn spatial data into smarter infrastructure solutions. #DistanceInfra #DI #WeAreHiring #Hiring #GIS #GISSpecialist #ArcGIS #ArcGISPro #QGIS #Geospatial #SpatialData #Infrastructure #BIM #Engineering #InfrastructureEngineering #EngineeringJobs #GISJobs #CairoJobs #EgyptJobs
